changelog:
Initial release of Film Photo Generator

- Generate analog-style film photos with 35mm grain, light leaks, and retro color palettes
- Supports vintage 70s/80s aesthetics, Kodak Portra, lomography, and Fujifilm simulation
- Customizable photo size: portrait, landscape, square, or tall
- Optional reference image support for style inheritance
- Requires a Neta API token (free trial available)
- Easy installation and usage via Bash or Node commands
